what: Revise waterfall plan/findings/feature blocks lack the verify-first/post-implement-gap qualifier that subprocess context bodies get in the same SECURITY.md draft sentence
scenario_or_breakage: Subprocess coverage is explicitly conditional ("applies only after verify-first read confirms hardening (or documents post-implement gap — FINDING_1)"), but revise waterfall blocks are listed as unconditionally requiring redact/escape/framing with no parallel gate even though Item 3 is verify-first and compose_prompt still raw-seds on main (revise-plan-with-waterfall.sh:143-149). A framing-only skip or partial migration could leave raw delimiter injection while SECURITY.md reads as if inline revise coverage is settled.
suggested_fix: Add a revise-specific mirror of the subprocess sentence, e.g. "Revise waterfall plan/findings/feature block coverage in this section applies only after verify-first migration to emit_untrusted_file_block (or documents post-implement gap — FINDING_1)."
